title: Notes on Wasserstein distance and wormholes
summary: We develop the Boltzmann-Wasserstein (BW) distance, a temperature-dependent metric on the space of quantum theories, defined as the optimal $W_2$ distance between Boltzmann-weighted energy spectra. Computing it is an optimisation over wormholes: each unitary identification of the two energy bases defines a coupling of the two boundaries in the doubled Hilbert space, and the optimum - the comonotone partition function $C_{\max}$, which pairs states by rank - is the dominant wormhole connecting the two theories.
